name: api
description: This project was bootstrapped with Fastify-CLI.

scripts.test: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test -r ts-node/register "test/**/*.ts"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')) for(const entry of fs.readdirSync('dist')) fs.rmSync(require('node:path').join('dist',entry), {recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:oxlint && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:oxlint -- --fix && npm run lint:eslint -- --fix
scripts.test:firestore: node -e "if (!process.env.FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST) { console.error('FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST is required'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run build:ts && node --test -r ts-node/register test/firestore.integration.ts test/firestore-snapshots.integration.ts test/firestore-jobs.integration.ts test/firestore-session.integration.ts test/firestore-worker.integration.ts test/firestore-http-worker.integration.ts test/firestore-administration.integration.ts test/firestore-api.integration.ts
